title: Suite version 0.1
description: An immutable evaluation-suite version: a frozen case selection plus the evaluator contract the selection is scored under. Cases are referenced by external id and normalized-scenario hash rather than copied, which is what lets a four-case checkpoint suite, a reviewed demo suite, and the full Base suite share one imported dataset version without duplicating records. This document is Redbeak-internal evidence and is never sent to a runner. It carries no expected values, rubrics, or thresholds: only the hash of the evaluator fixtures, whose contents stay in the private artifact directory.

case_manifest_sha256.description: Hash of the canonical `cases` array alone. This is the value a run manifest pins, so a reordered or edited selection cannot masquerade as the same suite version.

display_label.description: Operator-facing origin label. Demo v0 values are always Synthetic / BFCL-derived.

dataset_pin.description: The imported dataset version this suite selects from. Field names match the `dataset` block of run-manifest so a run can copy the pin without remapping.

selection.description: How this case set was chosen, recorded so the selection is reproducible and reviewable rather than an unexplained list of ids. `feature_basis` is load-bearing: a rule computed only from runner-visible features cannot itself disclose evaluator-private material, which is what allows the rule to be published beside the manifest.

feature_basis.description: Which class of case features the rule reads. `runner_visible` means turn count, domain, and mock tool-registry names only.

evaluator_contract.description: The versioned scoring contract this suite is evaluated under. `fixture_sha256` pins the private expected-evidence set for exactly this case selection without inlining any of it, so the suite manifest stays free of expected values.

assertion_kinds.description: Which observable assertion families the evaluator may draw on. Demo v0 judges observable response and outcome facts; tool-path disclosure is deliberately absent.

fixture_storage_ref.description: Opaque locator for the evaluator-private fixture set. Never a pre-signed URL or any string carrying a credential.

compatibility.description: The tuple two runs must agree on before their results may be compared as baseline and candidate. Recording it as one hash plus its inputs means a later comparison can refuse mismatched runs instead of silently averaging across different case sets or evaluator versions.

case_ref.description: A reference to one normalized scenario, not a copy of it. `scenario_sha256` binds the reference to exact bytes, so a suite cannot drift onto a mutated record while keeping its identity.

selection_stratum.description: Which stratum of a stratified rule placed this case in the suite. Absent for suites whose rule has no strata, such as the full-Base selection.
